parameters.name: AlertThresholdPct
parameters.description: The alert threshold, as a percentage. Valid values: 0 to 100.

parameters.name: BudgetDimensionRefId
parameters.description: The ID of the dimension object. This parameter is required if `BudgetType` is set to `ConsumerTotal` or `ConsumerGroupTotal`.

parameters.name: BudgetType
parameters.description:
The budget type. Valid values:

- `GlobalTotal`: global total budget

- `ConsumerTotal`: consumer total budget

- `ConsumerGroupTotal`: consumer group total budget

parameters.name: ResetDayOfMonth
parameters.description: The day of the month on which the budget resets. Valid values: 1 to 28.
